RoostIdle.note: Hang pose (fold 1, perch 1, feet IK on the bar); breath period 1 s; ear twitch 34-44

RoostAlert.note: fold 1 -> 0.82-0.90 (partial unwrap), ears alert, head lifts so the face points +X

Launch.note: feet on the bar until 5, perch off by 10; pelvis hang -> half-turn -> dive -> flight

Hover.note: flap keys 0 Up / 4 Power / 8 Down / 12 Recover / 15 = 0

FlyForward.note: Hover cycle, body pitched +24 deg, downstroke -38 instead of -50

Glide.note: spread glide + 1 s breath (spine/wing elev) and finger flex, all sin(2 pi t/30)

BankLeft.note: full pose = Hover frame 0 + body roll -25 deg toward the bat's own left, inner wing -30, outer -4 (raised by the roll), head counter-roll; additive reference = Hover frame 0. CSV says 0-0; padded to 2 identical samples because the Unreal FBX importer rejects a zero-length take

BankRight.note: full pose = Hover frame 0 + body roll +25 deg toward the bat's own right, inner wing -30, outer -4 (raised by the roll), head counter-roll; additive reference = Hover frame 0. CSV says 0-0; padded to 2 identical samples because the Unreal FBX importer rejects a zero-length take

Brake.note: one braking beat, then wings cup forward

Perch.note: brake -> pitch back with feet reaching (5) -> swing (9) -> feet on the bar at 12 (perch 1, IK) -> wrap by 24 = RoostIdle frame 0

Screech.note: anticipation dip 4, snap open 9, shudder 9-17, release by 24 (ends on Hover frame 0)

SwoopTelegraph.note: one beat down, rear up with wings high, hold quivering

Swoop.note: telegraph end -> tuck 5 -> feet/jaw strike 9 -> wings reopening into Hover frame 0 (pitched +6)

SwoopRecover.note: one hard pull-out beat, ends on Hover frame 0

Hit.note: snap at 2 (left wing flung up, right dropped, body rolled), settles to Hover frame 0

Stun.note: half-rate weak flap, lopsided body wobble, ears flat

DeathFall.note: hit jolt then wings go limp

DeathLand.note: impact at 3, one bounce, settled belly-down with wings flat by 18
